author: marketing_c
protectedRevelations: Later archive discoveries, human resistance outcomes, higher-level revelations and ending

scenes.title: A child with a world in her hands
scenes.viewerPurpose: Feel Iri’s hunger beside her unsettling power Enter a world left to children with a world below Notice needs they cannot put off while learning
scenes.composition: Iri is alone above an inhabited lower world
addOrChange: Add empty adult seats and a food place, with no deity glow or giant hands.

cues.narration: Iri can alter another person’s thoughts, but she cannot make her own empty home feed her.
cues.visualAction: Iri changes a small event below, then checks her empty food place.

cues.narration: The Orphan Gods begins after the adults vanish from a civilization above a simulated human world.
cues.visualAction: Reveal the empty seats and the lower world’s continuing life.

cues.narration: Its surviving children inherit powers they do not understand and needs they cannot postpone.
cues.visualAction: Iri pauses between unfamiliar controls and her immediate hunger.

scenes.title: After the adults vanish
scenes.viewerPurpose: Remember the people below also live and love Sense two worlds tied together by survival
scenes.composition: An ordinary household lives in the world below
addOrChange: Replace repeated empty shelter with people sharing a meal and a small view of Iri.

cues.narration: Below them, people fall in love, suffer, and try to make sense of unexplained events.
cues.visualAction: Let the family’s conversation continue before an unexplained interruption.

cues.narration: What happens to the people below seems to affect whether the children can survive.
cues.visualAction: Iri notices the lower-world event beside a change in her shelter’s supply.

scenes.title: The cost of staying alive
scenes.viewerPurpose: Feel choices reaching lives the children barely understand See frightened children rather than grand powerful gods Notice power arriving before understanding
scenes.composition: Two frightened children watch a person their intervention could affect
addOrChange: Replace abstract yield gauges with food, a control and a human witness.

cues.narration: Trying to meet their own needs means changing lives they barely understand.
cues.visualAction: The children approach the control, then notice the person below.

cues.narration: This speculative novel follows frightened young beings placed in the role of gods.
cues.visualAction: Keep their uncertain postures and small bodies visible.

cues.narration: They can change another life long before they know what that change will cost.
cues.visualAction: Follow the person’s immediate reaction without revealing later consequences.

scenes.title: Enter through Iri
scenes.viewerPurpose: Care about friendship and hunger before cosmic scale Follow Iri as people stop looking like movable figures
scenes.composition: Iri listens to a person rather than moving a control
addOrChange: Add the speaker at equal screen scale and keep hunger unobtrusive.

cues.narration: Friendship and hunger make the questions intimate long before they become cosmic.
cues.visualAction: A friend joins Iri beside the empty food place.

cues.narration: Follow Iri as the people below become more than figures she can move around.
cues.visualAction: Iri withdraws her hand and attends to the speaking person.
